_comment: Hand-maintained descriptions for the directives whose only text in the module source is an argument-shape hint (the Apache command table's help string, e.g. "name size_kb") or no text at all. Names, arity, scope and defaults come from the source; see generate-references.mjs. Every entry here is rendered with descriptionSource: docs.

directives.AddResourceHeader: Adds a custom HTTP header to every optimized resource the module serves. Repeatable, up to 20 headers.
directives.CustomFetchHeader: Adds a request header to every fetch the module makes to an origin.
directives.MapOriginDomain: Fetches resources for the public domain(s) from the origin domain instead, optionally sending a different Host header.
directives.MapProxyDomain: Proxies and optimizes resources from a separate origin domain under a path of this site.
directives.MapRewriteDomain: Rewrites optimized resource URLs from the listed domains onto another domain (for example a CDN hostname).
directives.ShardDomain: Spreads optimized resource URLs for a domain across the listed shard domains.
directives.CreateSharedMemoryMetadataCache: Creates a named shared-memory metadata cache of the given size for the virtual hosts whose FileCachePath is that name.
directives.LoadFromFile: Serves resources under a URL prefix straight from the filesystem instead of fetching them over HTTP.
directives.LoadFromFileMatch: LoadFromFile with a regular expression on the URL and a replacement filename prefix.
directives.LoadFromFileRule: Allows or disallows loading from file for a filename prefix after a LoadFromFile mapping.
directives.LoadFromFileRuleMatch: LoadFromFileRule with a regular expression on the filename.
directives.StatisticsDomains: Access control for the per-host statistics page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.
directives.GlobalStatisticsDomains: Access control for the global statistics page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.
directives.MessagesDomains: Access control for the message history page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.
directives.ConsoleDomains: Access control for the console page: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.
directives.AdminDomains: Access control for the per-host admin pages: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.
directives.GlobalAdminDomains: Access control for the global admin pages: Allow or Disallow a domain wildcard. Default: Allow *.
directives.Allow: Allows optimization of resources whose URL matches the wildcard. Later Allow and Disallow directives override earlier ones.
directives.Disallow: Excludes resources (and pages) whose URL matches the wildcard from optimization.
directives.Domain: Authorizes the module to fetch and rewrite resources on this domain.
directives.UrlValuedAttribute: Declares an extra element attribute that holds a URL, with the resource category (image, script, stylesheet, otherResource, hyperlink) it should be treated as.
directives.Library: Recognizes a JavaScript library by size and hash so canonicalize_javascript_libraries can replace it with the given canonical URL.
directives.NumRewriteThreads: Threads per process for short, latency-sensitive optimization work. auto (or 0) sizes the pool from the CPUs the process may use; a positive integer sets it exactly.
directives.NumExpensiveRewriteThreads: Threads per process for heavy optimization work such as image transcoding. auto (or 0) sizes the pool from the CPUs the process may use; a positive integer sets it exactly.
directives.MessageBufferSize: Size in bytes of the in-memory message history shown on the messages page; 0 disables it.
directives.ClearInheritedScripts: Drops the script-variable directive lines inherited from the enclosing block, so this block starts from the non-scripted configuration.
